rot.ideia.ex1.e1: King and pawn against king is the most important ending in chess. It comes up all the time.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: Key squares: the square two ranks ahead of the pawn and its two neighbours on the same rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: If your king steps on a key square, the pawn almost always promotes, whatever the other king does.
rot.ideia.ex1.e4: Bring the king to a key square of the e3 pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Bring the king to a key square, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! The king reached d5, a key square. The win is certain.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The king goes to d5, one of the pawn's key squares.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.c4c5.1: The king does not reach a key square, and the black king gets there first.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.c4c5.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.c4b5.1: The king does not reach a key square, and the black king gets there first.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.c4b5.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.

rot.ideia.ex1.err.c4d4.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.

rot.ideia.ex1.err.c4b4.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.

rot.ideia.ex1.err.c4d3.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.

rot.ideia.ex1.err.c4c3.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.

rot.ideia.ex1.err.c4b3.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3e4.1: The pawn advanced, and the key squares moved up with it, away from your king.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.e3e4.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Bring the king to a key square, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.livre.fala: Play on from here against the machine and see what happens.
rot.ideia.ex1.livre.volta: Let's go back to the position and bring the king forward.
rot.ideia.ex1.fins.afogado: Stalemate: Black had no move. It is a draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.fins.repeticao: The position repeated: the black king held the square in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: The black king cannot push the white king away.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: The white king keeps going ahead, clearing the way.
rot.ideia.ex1.l3: Remember: key squares, two ranks ahead of the pawn. The king gets there first.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: The king goes in front of the pawn, clearing the way, never behind. The pawn follows.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Do not push the pawn yet. Bring the king to the square right in front of it.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Bring the king in front of the pawn, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The king got in front of the pawn and reaches the key squares.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The king goes to e5, right in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d4c4.1: The king does not stay in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d4c4.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d4e3.1: The king does not stay in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d4e3.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.

rot.ideia.ex2.err.d4d3.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d4c3.1: The king does not stay in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.d4c3.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e4e5.1: The pawn went ahead of the king: too early.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e4e5.2: The black king takes the square in front of the pawn and holds the draw.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Bring the king in front of the pawn, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.livre.fala: Play on from here against the machine and see what happens.
rot.ideia.ex2.livre.volta: Let's go back to the position and bring the king forward.
rot.ideia.ex2.fins.afogado: Stalemate: Black had no move. It is a draw.
rot.ideia.ex2.fins.repeticao: The position repeated: the black king held the square in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The black king tries to get back in front of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: The white king steps on f6, a key square.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Remember: first the king, then the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.l4: Now I will show the key square that wins without the opposition and the pawn pushed too early.
rot.demos.casaChave.e1: The white king is on e4, a key square of the e2 pawn. Kings face to face, White to move.
rot.demos.casaChave.l1: A pawn move passes the turn: now the black king has to move and step aside.
rot.demos.casaChave.l2: The black king gives way on one side.
rot.demos.casaChave.l3: The white king advances on the other.
rot.demos.casaChave.l4: The king stays in front of the pawn all the way to the promotion square. The win is certain.
rot.demos.cedo.e1: Now the mistake: White pushes the pawn before bringing the king forward.
rot.demos.cedo.l2: The black king runs to the squares in front of the pawn.
rot.demos.cedo.l4: The black king holds the square in front.
rot.demos.cedo.l6: The black king steps back, still in front of the pawn.
rot.demos.cedo.l7: The white king protects the pawn.
rot.demos.cedo.l8: The black king takes the opposition.
rot.demos.cedo.l10: The black king stays on the promotion square.
rot.demos.cedo.l11: The white king protects the pawn.
rot.demos.cedo.l12: Black has no move, and there is no check: stalemate, a draw.
rot.demos.cedo.l13: Now it's your turn: king in front, key squares and the opposition when needed.
rot.pratica.ataque.enunciado: As White: bring the king to a key square of the d2 pawn, two ranks ahead. Then promote.
rot.pratica.ataque.fim: Promoted! This ending has decided world champions' games.
rot.pratica.defesa.enunciado: As Black: hold the draw. Stay on the squares in front of the pawn, always close to it.
rot.pratica.defesa.fim: Draw secured. The black king never left the pawn's path.
